name: photo-stack
title: Photo stack
description: A small pile of photos for an album or an attachment set: the cover on top, the rest peeking out at fixed angles, a count chip, and a fan on hover.
docs: photos takes up to five { src, alt }, the cover first; count is how many the album holds in all, and the chip shows how many the pile does not. The angles are fixed numbers, so server and browser draw the same pile. fanOnHover opens the pile on hover and keyboard focus; touch screens and reduced motion keep it closed. With href it is a link, with onClick and no href a button, with neither a labelled picture; the name is 'Summer 2025, 24 photos'. On a link or button with a caption the name is read from the caption itself, so what a voice-control user says matches what is on screen. showCaption puts the title and count under the pile; turn it off for the pile alone.
